title: YKONE Middle East
subtitle: An Egypt execution layer YKONE can sell to its clients under its own name: locations, permits, hospitality and talent hosting for creator trips, shoots and brand dinners.

items: 8 Oct 2026 · NOYA wrote after the call
Approve the master brief (v4), then send the follow-up in the 8 Oct thread with the PDF
Jad Chbeir · email from the thread

items.text: First email to Magali Rady: NOYA as YKONE's Egypt production and hospitality layer.
Magali replied the same day: YKONE is looking at the Egypt market; asked for a call.
Jad Chbeir confirmed Thursday 8 Oct, 3 pm London.
Call with Jad and Amal. NOYA Overview and Egypt Partner Guide sent the same day.
No reply since. Follow-up drafted in Gmail (unsent) with one Egypt idea.
Adam edited the follow-up draft in Gmail (unsent).
Brief v3 (text only) superseded by the master brief v4 with imagery; follow-up text updated to match.
YKONE is looking at the Egypt market and asked for a call.
items.source: Gmail: Magali Rady to noya@, 29 Sep 2026

items.text: Call held with Jad Chbeir (Commercial Director) and Amal on 8 Oct; NOYA Overview and Egypt Partner Guide sent the same day.
items.source: Gmail: noya@ to Jad and Amal, 8 Oct 2026; CRM opportunity ea415161

items.text: "YKONE leads the creative vision and brand relationships, while NOYA brings together the right people, places and experiences to make it happen."
Idea already offered in Adam's follow-up draft: a private brand dinner beside the Pyramids or at the Grand Egyptian Museum, with talent hosting by NOYA.
items.source: Gmail draft (unsent), recorded in the CRM 15 Oct 2026

items.text: YKONE is part of ONE Group, formed in January 2026 with Mirror Mirror (creative production) and others; the group has since taken a stake in BYSELECT, a UAE experiential agency.
items.source: Net Influencer and Entrepreneur coverage of ONE Group, 2026

items.text: No reply from YKONE since 8 Oct.
The Longines Global Champions Tour holds its first Egypt event at the Pyramids of Giza, 22–24 October 2026, the first year of a five-year agreement.
Forever Is Now 06, Art D’Égypte’s open-air exhibition on the Giza plateau, runs 4–28 November 2026.
Shakira performs at the Pyramids of Giza on 28 November 2026.
items.source: Ticket Egypt, official ticketing for Venture Lifestyle (HQ calendar, verified)

items.text: The Grand Egyptian Museum marks its first anniversary on 5 November 2026 with Gala de Danza, the company’s first performance in the Middle East.
items.source: Ticketsmarche, official ticketing presented by GEM Experience (HQ calendar, verified)

items.text: The 47th Cairo International Film Festival runs 11–20 November 2026.
No reply from YKONE since 8 Oct (12 days). Adam edited the follow-up draft in Gmail on 19 Oct; it is unsent.

items.source: NOYA reading of the facts above

rows: NOYA Brand Experience Desk (with NOYA Production Desk)
Objectives · Guest profile · Hosting programme · Suppliers and venues · Timeline · Fees (fixed hosting fee + pass-through).

blocks.label: Recommended · Master brief (2–3 pages)
blocks.big: YKONE met us and is looking at Egypt, but has not briefed us. A short visual brief shows what YKONE can sell in Egypt and asks for one brief.
blocks.text: Send with the follow-up in the 8 Oct thread once Adam approves it. Proposal and project book stay internal until YKONE shares a live brief.

items.text: Which YKONE client brief points to Egypt first, and when?
Does BYSELECT run YKONE's experiential work in the region, or does YKONE?
Guest profile: creators, press or clients?
Who signs off budgets: Magali or Jad?

rows: Then NOYA becomes the agency's ground partner in Egypt.
We only work with global suppliers.
NOYA can operate under the global supplier's contract as the Egypt layer.
NOYA complements fixers with hospitality and talent care at a higher standard.

items.text: Do not chase Magali and Jad separately: one thread, one follow-up.
No proposal goes out before YKONE shares a brief; the draft stays internal.
